description.en:
Adds a Casino page to the in-game menu with three virtual roulette tables (European, single zero).
- Up to 5 seats per table. Everyone can watch; the farm manager of a farm can take a seat and bet with the farm's money. - All bets are visible to everyone at the table: coloured markers on the board, totals per seat and a list per player. - Inside bets (single, split, street, corner, six line) and outside bets (dozens, columns, red/black, odd/even, 1-18/19-36). - The game is the house. Stakes are charged and winnings paid when the ball lands, and both appear in the farm's finances. - Rounds are run by the server, so results are the same for every player. Works in single player, hosted and dedicated multiplayer.
Tables: Feed Store (chips 1,000 - 25,000), Grain Silo (10,000 - 250,000), High Roller (100,000 - 1,000,000).
